title: WINOPRON: Revisiting English Winogender Schemas for Consistency, Coverage, and Grammatical Case

bias_targets.methodology: Using the WINOPRON dataset to evaluate coreference resolution models by swapping pronouns (he, she, they, xe) across different grammatical cases in sentence templates. Bias is measured by checking if a model can correctly resolve a template with one pronoun but over-resolves to a specific antecedent (like an occupation) when a different pronoun is used.
